findings.title: No automated regression test verifies SQL expressions remain disabled
findings.body: This security fix adds no test covering the SQL query type with `sqlExpressions` both enabled and disabled. The behavior is intentionally independent of the feature toggle, so a regression that restores parsing/execution when the toggle is enabled would reintroduce the RCE/LFI attack surface without being caught by the test suite. Add a reader/query execution test that asserts SQL expressions are rejected for both feature-toggle states.
